resolution.rejection_description: Rejected on a mandatory biometric update because fingerprint and iris matched a different parent Aadhaar completely while the face did not match it at all, which is the signature of a biometric mix-up between records.
resolution.synthesis: The resident submitted a first-time biometric update, which is de-duplicated like a fresh enrolment and must match no other identity. Another parent Aadhaar holds fingerprint and iris matching this resident fully while its face belongs to someone else, so one of the two records carries mixed-up biometrics and the packet was rejected. An operator must adjudicate the two records, since recapturing would simply reproduce the same match.
